verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI accepts natural-language instructions in specific places: the CLI takes a plain-English query (`crwl ... -q "Extract all product prices"`), extraction can be LLM-driven, and adaptive crawling stops once it has enough to answer a query. MCP integration also lets AI tools like Claude Code drive it conversationally. Core operation, though, is still configured through Python APIs and CLI flags rather than natural language. Missing for 10: end-to-end natural-language control of crawl configuration (deep crawl, browser and session settings), first-party docs detailing the NL query mode, and independent hands-on reports of operating the tool via natural language.
